name: Magazino SOTO
summary: A mobile robot that grips small load carriers (KLT, up to 20 kg each) at 0.4 to 1.7 m and carries 8 to 24 of them between storage and production lines on industrial floors.

germany.statusNote: Made in Germany by Magazino (Munich) and sold by Jungheinrich Vertrieb Deutschland; consultation on request, no public price. In routine use at VEGA, Bosch, MAN and others in Germany.

sellers.name: Jungheinrich Vertrieb Deutschland AG & Co. KG
sellers.note: Hamburg; free phone within Germany; contact form and consultation booking on the product page.

sellers.name: Magazino GmbH
sellers.note: Product page refers buyers to the Jungheinrich sales team or info@magazino.de.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: standard configuration; 686 to 735 kg depending on backpack

specs.label: Dimensions (L x W x H)
specs.conditions: plus 80 mm for the laser scanner in operation

specs.label: Total payload
specs.conditions: standard configuration; 200 to 249 kg depending on backpack (Magazino web page says up to 250 kg)

specs.label: Supported KLT sizes
specs.conditions: VDA 4500 R-KLT and RL-KLT; width must exceed height

specs.label: Max speed
specs.conditions: needs aisles of 2.51 m; 0.3 m/s from 1.65 m aisle width

specs.label: Operating temperature
specs.conditions: up to 35 C for up to 1 h

specs.label: Floor
specs.value: Industrial floor to DIN 18202:2019-07; bumps up to 5 mm

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 2D laser scanners front and rear, 3D cameras, light curtains at the gripper, barcode and QR scanners

specs.label: Integration
specs.value: VDA 5050 or Magazino Fleet Manager via REST interface to the WMS

capabilities.sdk: VDA 5050; Magazino Fleet Manager REST interface
notes: The gripper is a KLT handling unit on a lift, not a jointed arm; it picks containers from three sides and rotates them by 90 or 180 degrees.
Indoor only: IP20, 15 to 25 C, flat industrial floors with bumps up to 5 mm.
Needs aisles of at least 1.65 m (2.51 m for full speed) and weighs about 695 kg.
Handles standard KLTs only; other carriers such as EPP or cardboard must be checked case by case.
